name: The Fall
overview: The Fall describes humanity's entrance into sin through the disobedience of the first man and woman, as seen when the serpent deceived Eve and she ate the forbidden fruit, subsequently giving it to Adam (Genesis 3:1, 6). This act introduced sin and death into the world, affecting all people since all have sinned and fallen short of God's glory (Romans 3:23; Romans 5:12). Despite this, God's enduring word remains steadfast (Isaiah 40:8), and His love offers redemption through Christ, who grants eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16).
